decisions.reason: The single-board architecture makes the existing activation condition based on disconnecting the power board obsolete, but the source does not determine how USB auxiliary power will be isolated from or selected against the integrated AXP2101 supply.

The separate power-board and main-board wording becomes obsolete, but the source does not establish whether the 3.4V programming and Schottky-drop compensation circuit will remain unchanged in the cost-optimized integrated design.
The monitored load can no longer be described as combined main-board and sensor-board current because those loads are consolidated onto the single integrated board.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?
